title: Muse Video Project State
description: Single source of truth flowing between all roles in the Muse Video creative pipeline. Every role reads from and writes to this schema.

project.description: Core project metadata — populated during Phase 1 (需求沟通).

scene_type.description: Scene type — determines which references/scenes/<type>.md to load.

director_notes.description: Director's creative vision and decisions — the North Star for all roles.

constraints.description: Hard constraints (e.g., 'must include product logo in first 3s', 'no rapid cuts').

has_characters.description: Character presence — tri-state: true / false / uncertain (=null). Extracted during Phase 1 from the vision template (default.md §Phase 1 step 4b).

script.description: Script output from Writer + DP — populated during Phase 4 (脚本).

synopsis.description: Expanded story synopsis (one short paragraph) — Writer Phase 2.

summary.description: Scene summary — outline level (Phase 2; distinct from dialogue/action which are Phase 4).

emotional_curve.description: Emotional intensity marker for the scene (e.g., '3→5（好奇→期待）') — Writer annotation (optional).

narrative_function.description: The scene's narrative function (e.g., world-building / turning point / payoff) — Writer annotation (optional).

camera.description: DP's camera direction for this scene.

sound_notes.description: Sound design notes for this scene.

character_bible.description: Writer Phase 2 character identity definitions (identity + voice) — the authoritative source for AD visual translation (visual_dev.characters[]), Writer dialogue, and Sound voice signatures. Populated when director_notes.has_characters = true.

character_id.description: Stable character key (e.g., 'char_01') — matches visual_dev.characters[].character_id (cross-phase link).

identity.description: Identity template per writer.md §角色身份定义.

voice.description: Voice profile — authoritative input for Sound Designer voice signatures.

visual_dev.description: Visual development output from Art Director — populated during Phase 3 (美术定调+人物设定, now merged as '视觉开发'). Deprecated aliases (pre-v0.26, read-compat only): color_palette → palette, mood_references → style_refs, character_design → characters. New output must use the schema names.

palette.description: Color scheme — swatch entries (name/hex/usage) and/or per-scene entries (scene_id + palette + color_temp + mood + rationale); both styles coexist across projects.

items.description: Palette entry — swatch style (name/hex/usage) or per-scene style (scene_id/palette/color_temp/mood/rationale).

usage.description: How this color is used (e.g., 'primary bg', 'accent', 'text').

visual_cause.description: Mood → visual-cause translation (light direction / color temperature / intensity / atmospheric effects). Written by Art Director (Step 3b); consumed by DP and the model compiler.

scene_id.description: Scene number — for per-scene entries (matches script.scenes[].scene_id).

color_temp.description: Color temperature note (e.g., '5000K 晨光漫射' / '3200K golden backlight').

mood.description: Scene mood keywords for this palette entry.

palette.description: Role → hex color map (per-scene style). Common roles: primary / secondary / accent / background / text_light / text_dark; domain-specific roles allowed.

rationale.description: Why this palette was chosen — narrative / emotional link.

reference.description: Reference work cited for this palette (e.g., 'BR2049 — Los Angeles street tone').

style_direction.description: Style direction — feeds the 6-segment Style section (Phase 7.5 model compilation).

visual_cause.description: Project-level mood → visual-cause translation. Dual-write compatible with palette[].visual_cause — compilers read both (existing data compatibility).

description.description: What to borrow from this reference.

characters.description: Character visual designs — simple entries (traits/consistency_notes) and/or rich entries (character_id + visual_profile + wardrobe + props + silhouette); both styles coexist across projects.

items.description: Character entry — simple style or rich style (Art Director's visual translation of script.character_bible).

traits.description: Visual traits (age, build, hair, clothing, accessories).

ref_image_prompt.description: AI image generation prompt for this character.

consistency_notes.description: Key features to maintain across all panels.

character_id.description: Stable character key (e.g., 'char_01') — matches script.character_bible[].character_id (cross-phase link).

visual_profile.description: Physical appearance — Art Director's translation of character_bible identity into visual features. Object form for single characters; array form for grouped characters (tagged sub-profiles, one per member).

distinguishing_marks.description: Scars / tattoos / prosthetics / signature features — drives close-up timing.

items.description: Tagged sub-profile for grouped characters (e.g., one per crowd member).

wardrobe.description: Costume design — DP consumes materials for lighting and color contrast; Sound consumes materials for Foley.

generation_notes.description: AI image generation guidance for this character (scale, consistency strategy).

scene_composition.description: Per-scene spatial arrangement — the 'missing layer' between palette and DP camera (Art Director Phase 3). Rendered by creative-pack.md and consumed by prompt_assembler.py.

spatial_layout.description: Layer structure — what is where in the frame.

foreground.description: Foreground elements — blur / framing / occlusion, providing depth.

midground.description: Midground subject — character / product / core action.

background.description: Background environment — atmosphere / buildings / sky / light source.

key_props.description: Core props and their visual function.

primary.description: First fixation point — what the eye sees first.

tertiary.description: Third fixation point — environment / atmosphere elements.

eye_path.description: Eye path description (e.g., 'cup → up the arm → face → window light → back to cup').

depth_strategy.description: Depth strategy — shallow-DOF layering / linear perspective / color depth / atmospheric perspective / occlusion stacking.

rationale.description: Why this spatial design — narrative / emotional link.

world_building.description: World-building visual rules (sci-fi / fantasy), layered on top of scene_composition. Real data contains keys such as world_name / core_visual_principle. Tolerant definition — additionalProperties: true.

image_refs.description: Generated reference images for art direction approval.

silence_usage.description: How and when to use silence.

to_scene.description: Target scene id — null for a closing transition with no target scene (e.g., final fade to white / end).

storyboard.description: Final storyboard panels — the integration point of all prior phases.

prompt.description: AI image generation prompt for this panel.

refs_used.description: 本 panel 生成时注入的参考图（顶层 file_registry 逻辑名列表）— 批次 D / v0.32.0，optional，溯源用

creative_pack.description: Final assembled output — ready for downstream tools.

file_registry.description: 全管线参考图注册表（v0.31.0 从 model_compilation.file_registry 提升；optional）— Phase 1 起登记，全管线按逻辑名引用（file_id / local_path），不再重述参考图已有内容。批次 D（v0.32.0）起生图产物同登记：source: "generated"；panel 生成图 → role: "first_frame"，命名 first_frame_p<panel_id>；moodboard → role: "reference_image"。

file_id.description: Volcengine Files API file_id（未上传时为 'PENDING'）

local_path.description: 本地文件路径——缩略图渲染来源 + file_id 失效后重传备份

weight.description: reference_image_weight（0.0-1.0）：角色锚点 0.8-1.0 / 场景 mood 0.5-0.7 / 风格 0.4-0.5

source.description: 来源分类：用户提供 / 生图生成 / 网络搜索（含免版权与公开图库，2026-09-28 决策 1）

credit.description: 来源署名（搜索源：作者/平台，溯源元数据）

origin_url.description: 来源页 URL（搜索源可选）

image_gen.description: 生图模型选择与生成配置（批次 D / v0.32.0；optional）— Phase 3.5 步骤 0 选定，Phase 6/7 复用；路由与适配见 references/image-gen-routing.md。target_model 为自由字符串（不设 enum，解耦）。

target_model.description: 选定生图模型/工具标识（如 'doubao-seedream-4-5-251128' / 'comfyui-flux-ipadapter'）

selection_note.description: 选择依据/来源（探测结果 / 用户指定 / 帮我推荐）

adapter_status.description: 适配状态：measured（✅实测）/ doc-inferred（📄文档推断·未实测）

model_compilation.description: Model Compiler output — Phase 7.5. Compiles Creative Package into model-specific execution instructions. Read-only consumer of upstream data. Does not execute network requests.

file_registry.description: Uploaded reference image file_id registry. Each entry maps a logical name to its Files API file_id and local path backup. Legacy path — dual-read compatible: v0.31.0 promoted this registry to the top-level file_registry (authoritative); compilers read top-level first, falling back here.

local_path.description: Local file path for re-upload if file_id expires

weight.description: reference_image_weight (0.0-1.0). Character anchor: 0.8-1.0, scene mood: 0.5-0.7, style: 0.4-0.5

panel_id.description: 对应 storyboard panel 的 panel_id（编译器写入；批次 D / v0.32.0）— first_frame_ref 解析键：first_frame_p<panel_id>

compiled_prompt.description: Compiled 6-segment prompt ready for model consumption

prompt_trace.description: Optional — segment-level traceability from source fields to compiled text. Director may delete after review to reduce schema size.

multimodal_refs.description: Model-agnostic multimodal reference mapping. File IDs resolved via file_registry at execution time.

arkcli_command.description: Ready-to-execute arkcli command (text only, not auto-executed)

estimated_tokens.description: Estimated token consumption for this shot

shot_chain.description: video_ref chain for shot-to-shot style consistency (Seedance 2.0 only)

tuning_notes.description: Director's final tuning and optimization notes.

trace_entry.description: Segment-level traceability: maps a compiled prompt segment back to its source field and original text.
